sources.title: Download the Wells Fargo Mobile app
sources.page_scope: Brief S20. App landing page: feature list, FAQs, footnotes for mobile deposit, Zelle, external transfers, Fargo.
sources.claim: App lets users monitor balances and transactions, set up alerts, open new accounts, send money with Zelle, transfer between accounts, pay bills, deposit checks, activate/replace cards, find ATMs, enable push notifications, use a digital wallet, view online statements; Ask Fargo is exclusively in the mobile app; Fargo only on smartphone versions; Zelle footnote says neither Wells Fargo nor Zelle offers purchase protection; external transfer setup verification may take 1-3 business days.
caveats: Ratings claim is dated 'as of July 1, 2025' while page is observed 2026-10-10.
Page footer code DT1-10022027 is an internal code, not a visible update date.
sources.local_note: Neither Wells Fargo nor Zelle offers purchase protection for payments made with Zelle - for example, if you do not receive the item you paid for or the item is not as described or as you expected. Fargo is only available on the smartphone versions of the Wells Fargo Mobile app.

sources.title: Plan for your financial future (financial tools and services)
sources.page_scope: Brief S21. Financial tools hub linked from the app marketing: FICO/Credit Close-Up, debt, investment options, language preferences.
sources.claim: Lists: get access to FICO Score, receive credit monitoring alerts, review Experian credit report; compare what you owe to what you earn, see if comfortable with debt, consider borrowing; WellsTrade DIY investing, Intuitive Investor automation, work with a Financial Advisor; plan for life events. FICO requires eligible consumer account with FICO Score available and Wells Fargo Online enrollment. Investment products not FDIC insured, offered through Wells Fargo Advisors (WFCS). Intuitive Investor minimum account size $500.
caveats: Investing/advisory items are WFCS (non-bank affiliate) products, not app account servicing.
Score is educational and may not be the score used for credit decisions.
sources.local_note: Get access to your FICO Score; Receive credit monitoring alerts; Review your Experian credit report. Investment and Insurance Products are: Not Insured by the FDIC... offered through Wells Fargo Advisors... WFCS. The minimum account size for this program is $500.

sources.title: Manage accounts with mobile banking
sources.page_scope: Mobile/online account management marketing page with FAQs.
sources.claim: Check balances, view all transactions, track activity; overdraft protection; manage digital wallet; turn cards off/on; alerts by email, text, or push (upcoming payments, pending transactions); paperless statements (deposit statements up to 7 years); Quicken sync; Fargo can show spending by category and purchases by retailer.
caveats: Quicken is a third-party (Quicken, Inc.) product.
sources.local_note: Monitor your money: Check your balances, View all transactions, Track account activity. Set up alerts: Choose email, text, or push notifications.

sources.title: Transfer and pay with mobile banking
sources.page_scope: Transfers, Zelle, Bill Pay, digital wallet, wires, ExpressSend overview.
sources.claim: Zelle send/request with trusted people with U.S. bank accounts; transfers between Wells Fargo accounts and to/from other U.S. financial institutions, automatic transfers; Bill Pay one-time or recurring within U.S.; digital wallets (iOS: Paze, Apple Pay, PayPal; Android: Paze, Google Pay, Samsung Pay, PayPal); digital wires domestic and abroad; ExpressSend remittances to 12 countries (first remittance in person; online ExpressSend desktop/laptop only); Fargo can send money to stored contacts.
caveats: Wire fee amounts are not on this page (see CR-WF-23).
sources.local_note: Use ExpressSend to send money to people in 12 countries... Customers must use a desktop or laptop to conduct online ExpressSend transfers. Easily tell Fargo to send money to your stored contacts.

sources.title: Mobile deposit: how it works
sources.page_scope: Step-by-step mobile check deposit guide (redirected from /mobile/apps/mobile-deposit/).
sources.claim: Deposit to eligible checking or savings; select Deposit in bottom bar; app displays remaining daily and 30-day mobile deposit limit on Enter Amount screen; endorse 'For Mobile Deposit at Wells Fargo Only'; on-screen and email confirmation; keep check 5 days.
caveats: Exact dollar limits are not published; shown per account in-app.
sources.local_note: Enter the check amount. Your account's remaining daily and 30-day mobile deposit limit will also display on the screen.

sources.title: Mobile deposit FAQs
sources.page_scope: Help FAQ for mobile deposit: eligibility, availability, limits, fees.
sources.claim: Eligible: Wells Fargo Online / Business Online customers with eligible checking or savings. Ineligible items listed (international checks, savings bonds, USPS money orders, etc.). Business day before 9 pm PT: generally available next day; after 9 pm PT or weekend/holiday: day after next business day. Limits shown per eligible account in-app. No fee for most customers; some analyzed business accounts may be charged.
caveats: CONTRADICTION/nuance with CR-WF-19 (OAA 9(d)): OAA says first $400 of a business day's mobile check deposits generally available on the day received; FAQ says money generally available next day.
sources.local_note: If you deposit on a business day before 9 pm PT, your money will generally be available the next day. For most customers, there's no fee to use Mobile Deposit.

sources.title: Zelle FAQs
sources.page_scope: Help FAQ for Zelle within Wells Fargo: protections, fees, limits, send/request/schedule/cancel.
sources.claim: No Wells Fargo fee to send/receive. Consumer limits: up to $3,500 per rolling 24 hours and $20,000 per rolling 30 days; business: $15,000 / $60,000; no receiving limit. Unauthorized-access protection only; not the same protections as credit/debit card transactions; no purchase protection; qualifying imposter scams may be eligible for reimbursement. Unenrolled recipient has 14 days to enroll. Scheduled payments up to a year ahead; cancel scheduled until 11:30 pm PT day before. First-time recipient requires access-code verification.
caveats: Limits may vary by account/history and may be adjusted at any time; some consumers may see higher limits.
sources.local_note: Customers with a Wells Fargo consumer account can send up to $3,500 in a rolling 24-hour period and up to $20,000 in a rolling 30-day period. Because Zelle is intended to replace instances where cash and checks are being exchanged, you do not have the same protections associated with a credit card or a debit card transaction.

sources.title: Zelle Transfer Service Addendum to the Online Access Agreement
sources.page_scope: Legal terms for Zelle (redirected from /online-banking/transfers/zelle-terms/). Shows 'Effective September 15, 2026'.
sources.claim: Zelle intended for friends, family and others you trust; should not be used with unfamiliar/untrusted recipients; no purchase protection for authorized payments; reimbursement available for unauthorized transactions or certain qualifying imposter scams; payments generally cannot be stopped once sent unless recipient not enrolled.
caveats: 'Effective' date treated as visible update date.
sources.local_note: ZELLE DOES NOT OFFER PURCHASE PROTECTION FOR AUTHORIZED PAYMENTS MADE THROUGH THE ZELLE TRANSFER SERVICE (FOR EXAMPLE, IF YOU DO NOT RECEIVE THE GOODS OR SERVICES THAT YOU PAID FOR...). REIMBURSEMENT IS AVAILABLE FOR UNAUTHORIZED TRANSACTIONS OR TRANSACTIONS RESULTING FROM CERTAIN QUALIFYING IMPOSTER SCAMS.

sources.title: Fargo, your banking virtual assistant
sources.page_scope: Official Fargo product page on Wells Fargo's sites.wf.com domain (linked from CR-WF-01).
sources.claim: Fargo in the mobile app: 30-day balance forecast, 14-day activity forecast, spending insights by category/merchant, subscription insights across Wells Fargo accounts; tasks: which bills are due, make a payment or transfer, view Zelle transactions, recent transactions, routing number, turn card off; voice or text; English and Spanish; available to customers with a consumer account; smartphone app only; if it cannot answer, directs to Customer Service.
caveats: App Store rating claim dated May 19, 2025.
Underlying model/grounding method not publicly documented.
sources.local_note: Fargo is available to Wells Fargo customers that have a consumer account. Fargo is available in English and Spanish. If Fargo can't answer your question, Fargo will direct you to Customer Service.

sources.title: Credit Close-Up: your FICO Score
sources.page_scope: Credit Close-Up enrollment page.
sources.claim: Free access to FICO Score; FICO Score and Experian credit report every month; alerts on activity that may change score; full access to Experian credit report; personalized insights; enroll with online banking credentials; won't impact credit score. Eligibility: eligible consumer account with FICO Score available, enrolled in Wells Fargo Online. Score educational; WF and Fair Isaac are not credit repair organizations.
caveats: Whether full Experian report is viewable inside the mobile app vs. web is not stated.
sources.local_note: Your FICO Score and Experian credit report every month. Alerts to stay informed of activity that may change your credit score. Full access to your Experian credit report.

sources.title: How to calculate your debt-to-income ratio
sources.page_scope: DTI education page.
sources.claim: DTI = monthly debt payments / gross monthly income; lists included debts; calculator is educational and not a denial or approval of credit.
sources.local_note: Your debt-to-income ratio (DTI) compares how much you owe each month to how much you earn. This calculator is for educational purposes only and is not a denial or approval of credit.

sources.title: Debt-to-income calculator
sources.page_scope: Public DTI calculator with range interpretations and before-borrowing guidance.
sources.claim: Ranges: 35% or less 'looking good'; 36%-49% 'opportunity to improve'; 50% or more 'should take action'; next steps: estimate new payment and recalculate; consider existing credit before applying; lenders consider DTI and credit history/score.
caveats: Calculator outputs computed client-side; page rendered with default $0 values.
sources.local_note: 35% or less: Your DTI ratio is looking good. 36% - 49%: You have an opportunity to improve your DTI ratio. 50% or more: You should take action to improve your DTI ratio.

sources.title: Manage credit and debt
sources.page_scope: Financial-health education page on debt and credit.
sources.claim: Education on listing debts, budgeting, avalanche/snowball repayment, on-time payments, consolidation considerations, Wells Fargo Assist for struggling customers, credit counselor.
sources.local_note: Learn about different debt repayment strategies, such as the avalanche and snowball strategies. If you're struggling to make payments on a Wells Fargo account, visit Wells Fargo Assist.

sources.title: Financial health tools
sources.page_scope: Directory of financial tools.
sources.claim: Credit Close-Up gives customers complimentary access to FICO Credit Score, debt-to-income ratio, and more; DTI calculator; LifeSync; debt consolidation calculator.
sources.local_note: Wells Fargo customers can enroll in Credit Close-Up to get complimentary access to their FICO Credit Score, debt-to-income ratio, and more.

sources.title: LifeSync
sources.page_scope: LifeSync goals feature page (redirected from wellsfargo.com/lifesync/).
sources.claim: In-app goal setting and tracking (18 goal types, unlimited goals, connect accounts to track progress), snapshot (Rewards balances, FICO Score, market performance), newsfeed of educational content; English and Spanish; smartphone app only.
caveats: FICO in LifeSync subject to Credit Close-Up eligibility.
sources.local_note: There is no limit to the number of goals you may set. There are eighteen goal types to choose from. LifeSync is available exclusively in the Wells Fargo Mobile app for smartphones.

sources.title: Profile FAQs: language preferences
sources.page_scope: Profile and Language Preference FAQs.
sources.claim: Language Preference English or Spanish applies to browser, app, eligible alerts/communications; set in app via Menu > Security & Profile > Language Preference; may not be available in Spanish to all customers; English terms govern disputes; ATM language separate; statements language via phone/branch. Guest Users via Account Access Manager get view-only access.
caveats: CONTRADICTION with CR-WF-32 (App Store lists 7 languages).
sources.local_note: Language Preference allows you to set your preferred language to English or Spanish... Wells Fargo Online and the Wells Fargo Mobile app may not be available in Spanish to all customers.

sources.title: Supported browsers and Wells Fargo Mobile app requirements
sources.page_scope: Supported browsers and minimum mobile OS.
sources.claim: As of September 2026: iPhone iOS 15 or higher; iPad iPadOS 15 or higher; Android phone and tablet Android OS 11 or higher. Browsers: Edge 79+, Firefox 69+, Safari 13.1+, Chrome 70+. Beta OS not supported.
caveats: CONTRADICTION: header says 'Last updated: September 11, 2024' but body says 'As of September 2026'.
sources.local_note: As of September 2026... iPhone: iOS 15 or higher; iPad: iPadOS 15 or higher; Android phone and tablet: Android OS 11 or higher.

sources.title: Hardware and software requirements
sources.page_scope: General technical requirements.
sources.claim: Recommend latest app/browser; may block browsers/software for security without notice; 128-bit encryption minimum; text-enabled device needed for text alerts.
sources.local_note: In certain circumstances, we may block certain browsers and software from accessing Wells Fargo Online and Wells Fargo Mobile app due to possible security risks.

sources.title: Wells Fargo Online Access Agreement
sources.page_scope: Master digital banking agreement (Bill Pay, transfers, wires, mobile deposit, fees). Shows 'Version Effective May 21, 2026' and an upcoming version effective November 24, 2026.
sources.claim: No monthly service fee for Bill Pay; Bill Pay instant payments capped at $50,000 per payment; Transfer & Payments Service limits set by account agreement and risk, may change; non-WF accounts verified (test deposits); ACH inbound from external accounts generally held 3-4 business days; WF may charge transfer fees disclosed in advance; no fee for Mobile Deposit (some business accounts excepted); first $400 of a business day's mobile check deposits generally available same day; no trade instructions via chat/virtual assistant; consumer international wires cancellable within 30 minutes.
caveats: An upcoming version (effective 2026-11-24) was not reviewed.
No specific external-transfer dollar fees or limits are published in the agreement.
sources.local_note: You may not send more than $50,000.00 through the Bill Pay instant payments service in a single payment. The first $400 of a business day's check deposits with the Wells Fargo Mobile app will generally be available on the day we receive the deposits. You will not provide, and we cannot accept, trade instructions in any chat, virtual assistant, or similar service.

sources.title: Account alerts
sources.page_scope: Alerts feature page (redirected from /online-banking/alerts/).
sources.claim: Alerts for low balance, recent deposits, upcoming payments, security/sign-on activity; delivery by email, text, or push; dollar thresholds/frequency; eligible accounts: checking, savings, ATM/debit cards, credit cards, mortgage/home equity, CDs, personal lines/loans, auto loan; Wells Fargo Retail Services cards not eligible for subscription alerts; text alerts need enrollment via shortcode 93557.
sources.local_note: Choose the alerts you want and how you want to receive them - email, text message, or push notification. Wells Fargo Retail Services credit cards... are not eligible for subscription based alerts.

sources.title: Online transfers
sources.page_scope: Transfers feature page (redirected from /online-banking/transfers/).
sources.claim: Transfer between Wells Fargo accounts immediately; recurring transfers to savings; payments to WF credit/loan accounts funded from WF or other U.S. banks; bank-to-bank transfers via Add Non-Wells Fargo Accounts with 1-3 business day verification; edit/delete via Transfer in app bottom bar.
caveats: No external-transfer fee or dollar limit published here; page directs to other institutions for their fees.
sources.local_note: To enable non-Wells Fargo accounts for Transfers, additional security measures are required. Verification may take 1-3 business days.

sources.title: Bill Pay
sources.page_scope: Bill Pay feature page (redirected from /online-banking/bill-pay/).
sources.claim: No monthly service fee; WF loans pre-loaded as payees; one-time/recurring/auto pay; eBills; payment guarantee if sufficient funds; email reminders/confirmations; no overdraft fees on Bill Pay transactions but they can contribute to overdrafts; mobile app supported.
sources.local_note: There's no monthly service fee to use Bill Pay... We don't charge overdraft fees on Bill Pay transactions, but Bill Pay transactions can contribute to overdrafts.

sources.title: Digital wires
sources.page_scope: Wires feature page (redirected from /online-banking/wires/).
sources.claim: $30 fee for digital wires, $40 for branch wires; may be waived for eligible accounts; U.S. and 200+ countries; domestic same business day if submitted by 3:00 pm PT; daily and rolling 30-day limits vary (amounts not published); requires U.S. residence (not U.S. territories) and U.S. mobile number or RSA SecurID; FX markup.
caveats: Steps describe Wells Fargo Online (Transfer & Pay > Wire Money); in-app wire availability not explicitly stated.
sources.local_note: Wells Fargo charges a $30 fee for digital wires and a $40 fee for branch wires. Other fees may apply. Fees may be waived if funded from an eligible Wells Fargo account type.

sources.title: Checking accounts
sources.page_scope: Checking product comparison and opening requirements.
sources.claim: Everyday ($15 or $0 fee, 17+, 18 to open online), Clear Access Banking ($5 or $0, 13+, 18 online), Prime ($25 or $0, 18+, 19 in AL), Premier ($35 or $0, 18+, 19 in AL). Open online (18+) or branch; need SSN, valid ID, residential address, $25 opening deposit. Overdraft fee $35/item, max 3/day (not Clear Access).
caveats: Does not state whether opening can be completed inside the mobile app specifically.
sources.local_note: You can open a checking account online or in-person at a Wells Fargo branch. You must be 18 or older to apply online. 17 and under must open at a branch. ... $25 opening deposit.

sources.title: How Wells Fargo protects you
sources.page_scope: Security overview.
sources.claim: 24/7 fraud monitoring; automatic sign-off; Zero Liability protection for Wells Fargo debit and credit cards for promptly reported unauthorized card transactions; 2-step verification, biometric sign-on, Advanced Access codes.
caveats: Zero Liability applies to unauthorized card transactions, not to authorized Zelle payments or purchase disputes.
sources.local_note: Zero Liability protection: We offer Zero Liability protection with Wells Fargo debit and credit cards at no extra cost. You will not be held responsible for promptly reported unauthorized card transactions.

sources.title: Fraud and security
sources.page_scope: Fraud education hub with FAQs.
sources.claim: Scam red flags: urgent messages, unexpected contact, emotional pressure, unusual payment requests such as gift cards, crypto, wire transfers, large in-branch withdrawals; report unauthorized transactions immediately; elder-scam help line.
sources.local_note: Scams often involve urgent messages, unexpected contact, emotional pressure, or unusual payment requests like gift cards, crypto, wire transfers, or large in-branch withdrawal requests.

sources.title: Mobile features FAQs
sources.page_scope: Mobile help FAQs: alerts, push notifications, digital wallets, biometrics.
sources.claim: Alerts are a no-fee service for Wells Fargo Online customers; push notifications for Apple/Android phone or tablet; non-urgent card alerts processed nightly and sent next business day; no WF fee for digital wallets.
sources.local_note: Is there a fee for the alerts service? No. This is a no-fee service to all Wells Fargo Online customers.

sources.title: WellsTrade online brokerage
sources.publisher: Wells Fargo Advisors (Wells Fargo Clearing Services, LLC)
sources.page_scope: WellsTrade self-directed brokerage page (offered through WFCS).
sources.claim: $0 minimum to open; $0 online stock/ETF trades; $25 agent-assisted trade fee; no-load transaction-fee mutual funds $35; single sign-on with WF banking; Brokerage Cash Services incl. mobile deposit and Zelle; open by phone 1-877-573-7997 for some account types; not FDIC insured; WFCS member SIPC.
caveats: Securities product of a non-bank affiliate; not app account servicing.
sources.local_note: $0 minimum to open account; $0 per online stock and ETF trade. Investment and Insurance Products are: Not Insured by the FDIC.

sources.title: Intuitive Investor automated investing
sources.publisher: Wells Fargo Advisors (Wells Fargo Clearing Services, LLC)
sources.page_scope: Intuitive Investor (robo-advisory) program page.
sources.claim: $500 initial investment (180 days to meet); 0.35% annual advisory fee with discounts for Prime/Premier/Private Bank Interest Checking links; promotion '$0 advisory fees in 2026' for accounts opened with at least $50,000; 90-day satisfaction guarantee; optional tax loss harvesting; ETF portfolios; withdrawals via Pay and Transfer in mobile app.
caveats: Promotion funding window ended September 30, 2026 per FAQ but promo banner still displayed on 2026-10-10.
Advisory program through WFCS; not FDIC insured.
sources.local_note: Start investing with just $500 and 0.35% annual advisory fee. $0 advisory fees in 2026 when you open an automated investing account with at least $50,000.

sources.title: Intuitive Investor FAQs
sources.publisher: Wells Fargo Advisors (Wells Fargo Clearing Services, LLC)
sources.page_scope: Intuitive Investor FAQ.
sources.claim: Promo requires $50,000 initial funding between March 27, 2026 and September 30, 2026; accounts not funded within 180 days closed; balance below $100 for 30 days after quarter end converts to WellsTrade self-directed account; Intuitive Investor Cash shows in WF Transfer & Pay and Mobile deposit; questionnaire-driven ETF portfolio.
sources.local_note: Your Intuitive Investor account will display as Intuitive Investor Cash within Wells Fargo Transfer & Pay and Wells Fargo Mobile deposit.

sources.title: Find a Financial Advisor
sources.publisher: Wells Fargo Advisors (Wells Fargo Clearing Services, LLC)
sources.page_scope: Advisor discovery page.
sources.claim: Find an Advisor by ZIP tool; advisors in WFA offices, Wells Fargo Bank branches, and by phone; call 1-866-224-5708.
caveats: In-app entry point for advisor discovery not documented publicly.
sources.local_note: You'll find our Financial Advisors in Wells Fargo Advisors office locations, in Wells Fargo Bank branches, and over the phone. Use the Find an Advisor tool.

sources.title: Wells Fargo Mobile on the App Store
sources.publisher: Apple App Store (developer listing by Wells Fargo)
sources.page_scope: Developer's App Store listing; version 26.09.02 dated Oct 3.
sources.claim: Seller Wells Fargo Bank; requires iOS 15.0 / iPadOS 15.0 or later; languages English + 6 (French, Portuguese, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, Vietnamese); features: Touch ID/Face ID access, activity/balances, card on/off, digital wallets, mobile deposit, transfers, Zelle, bill pay, WellsTrade balances/holdings/open orders, quotes, Security Center fraud reporting, alerts, FICO Credit Score access.
caveats: CONTRADICTION with CR-WF-16: App Store lists 7 languages; Wells Fargo language preference offers only English or Spanish.
Version date shown as 'Oct 3' without year; assumed 2026.
sources.local_note: Requires iOS 15.0 or later. Languages: English, French, Portuguese, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, Vietnamese. Monitor balances, holdings, account activity, and open orders for your WellsTrade accounts.

sources.title: La app de Wells Fargo Mobile (Spanish)
sources.page_scope: Spanish-language version of the app landing page.
sources.claim: Official Spanish-language marketing/FAQ page for the app exists.
sources.local_note: Descargue la app de Wells Fargo Mobile. Preguntas frecuentes sobre la app de Wells Fargo Mobile.

sources.title: Financial health hub
sources.page_scope: Financial-health education hub linked from S21 'Plan for life events'.
sources.claim: Sections: manage credit and debt, plan for retirement, care for life events (advice on life changes); tools: Credit Close-Up, DTI calculator.
sources.local_note: Care for life events: Get advice on life changes that may impact your finances.
